Author: Salil Kumar Rai
Bench: Salil Kumar Rai
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 43
Case :- Writ - C No. - 19181 of 2011
Petitioner :- Smt. Dulari

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Respondent :- State of U.P. and Others Counsel for Petitioner :- Shiv Babu Dubey Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,A.P.Srivastava,Shri Kant,Vivek Saran Hon'ble Salil Kumar Rai,J.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
Heard the counsel for the petitioner and Shri Vivek Saran, counsel for the respondent no.4.

The petition has been filed for a mandamus commanding the Special Land Acquisition Officer,
Ghaziabad to decide the application of the petitioner filed under Section 30 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereinafter referred to as Act, 1894) for payment of compensation for the plot acquired in the year 1998.
It has been stated in the petition that the petitioner is not being paid the compensation as he was not recorded as a tenure holder in the revenue records at the time of acquisition.
The petitioner has annexed a copy of the sale deed showing that he has purchased the acquired Plot in 1984-1985 by the recorded tenure holder.

Smt. Dulari vs State Of U.P. And Others on 14 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143623118/

entities.text: Smt. Dulari vs State Of U.P. And Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the claim made by the petitioner, the petition is disposed of with a direction to the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Ghaziabad to decide the application of the petitioner filed under Section 30 of the Act, 1894 on 16.12.2010 and take appropriate action in accordance with law depending on his decision after giving an opportunity of hearing to the recorded tenure holder or his legal representatives.

The said decision shall be taken by the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Ghaziabad within a period of six months from today and the compensation amount deposited shall be disbursed to the rightful claimant within one month from the date of the decision of the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Ghaziabad.
With the aforesaid directions, the petition is disposed of.

Order Date :- 14.3.2023 IB  Smt. Dulari vs State Of U.P. And Others on 14 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143623118/
